proposal.root_cause: Model generates queries with incorrect column projections (SELECT * instead of specific columns) or missing DISTINCT for join-induced duplicates, causing execution accuracy failures despite correct filtering logic.
proposal.what: Update the system prompt to explicitly instruct the model to use SELECT DISTINCT when joining tables that may produce duplicate rows (e.g., one-to-many relationships) and to strictly select only the columns requested in the question, avoiding SELECT * unless all columns are explicitly needed. This addresses sp0600 (duplicates) and sp0755 (wrong projection).
